applies_to.quote: All Category – I Authorised Dealer Banks
AD Category – I banks may bring the contents of this circular to the notice of their exporter constituents

answer.action: Authorised Dealer Category-I banks must notify their exporter constituents about the Exim Bank Line of Credit details.
answer.action_quote: Authorised Dealer (AD) Category- I banks may allow such remittance after realization of full eligible value of export, subject to compliance with the extant instruct ions for payment of agency commission.

effective_date.quote: The Agreement under the LoC is effective from August 27, 2026.
